meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后,想设置或查看云同步时,Claude 会检查同步状态。需要连接时,向你要 cmem.ai 的三个连接值(令牌、用户ID、Hub地址),写入配置并重启验证,报告设备、进度和错误,且不显示令牌。
howto.when: 当你说出“set up cloud sync”、“sync my memories”、“cloud backup”等,或想把记忆数据库备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.note: 会向你要令牌、用户ID和Hub地址
会报告设备、同步进度和错误

say.text: 把记忆备份到 cmem.ai 账户
say.note: 会引导你完成连接配置

howto.what_en: When setting up or checking cloud sync, Claude checks status; to connect, it asks for the three cmem.ai values (token, user ID, Hub URL), writes, restarts, verifies, reports device/progress/errors, and never shows the token.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cloud backup", or requests to back up/sync the memory database to a cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync for me
say_en.note: Asks for your token, user ID, and Hub URL.
Reports device, sync progress, and errors.

say_en.text: Back up my memories to my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Guides you through the connection setup.
